title: Images default to 1024×1024
summary:
Bigger default images, a more practical assistant persona, and a new route behind `llama`.

Image requests without dimensions now default to 1024×1024 instead of 768×768, and Flux Schnell gained a 1024×1024 generation path through Cloudflare Workers AI. The same PR reduced the maximum side lengths for Flux and Turbo, removed four image models, and moved the `llama` text route to Llama 3.3 70B Instruct FP8 Fast.

The text service gained a Realistic persona prompt that combines practical problem-solving, investigation, brainstorming, and advice shaped by real-world constraints.

The homepage and README added links to a community Node.js package for image generation and LLM access, plus a dashboard for monitoring text and image servers.
